notes:
Summary: evaluation for RAG-based agent-assist over multi-source support KBs. Wants high-precision citations and freshness filtering.

Context and asks:
- Customer: midsize CCaaS provider, integrates with enterprise telco partners. Heavy ticket volume (peak 2.5k concurrent agent-assist sessions) during promo events.
- Primary goal: reduce average handle time (AHT) and escalate accuracy; automate post-call ticket summarization and CRM tool-calls.
- Data sources: Zendesk (tickets + macros), Confluence KB, S3 archive of PDF manuals, and live product telemetry via BigQuery. Need connectors and dedup + freshness windows.
- Requirements called out on call: citation links in bot responses, per-source provenance, TTL-based freshness, ability to invalidate stale docs, and a human-in-loop review path for suggested KB changes.
- Latency/throughput targets: 95th pct token latency < 400ms for short agent prompts; scale to 2500 concurrent retrieval+generate sessions for peaks.
- Model preferences: open Llama-variant families OK; fallback to smaller distilled models for cost controls; prefer tokenization/quantization guidance.
- Reliability concerns: must maintain service during spikes; wants reserved capacity option and routing by region.
- Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 baseline, audit logs for RAG retrievals, KMS for keys, EU data residency for European customers.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to buy Dedicated/Private for SLA-critical flows, keep hosted for general experiments.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "If the assistant pulls the wrong procedure during a high-severity outage, we lose trust quickly." — Head of Support
- "Citations are non-negotiable for compliance reviews." — Legal

POC plan (proposed):
- Week 0: NDA + security questionnaire + sample dataset checklist.
- Week 1: Ingest connectors (Zendesk, Confluence), run initial embedding pipeline, build retriever.
- Week 2: Configure citation policy, set freshness TTLs, run 500-session load test.
- Week 3: Integrate tool-calling flows (ticket update, escalate, add note) in sandbox.
- Week 4: Joint review, quality evals (precision@k, hallucination rate), SLA profiling, handoff SOW for production.

Open items / blockers to resolve before POC kickoff:
- Legal sign-off on transcript retention and EU residency.
- Sample of 1M tickets anonymized for indexing (they are preparing export).
- Concerns about hallucination mitigation and QA tooling for KB edits.
